_comment: Oldest library version the purego backend supports, per GIR namespace. A function newer than this must be registered as optional and guarded at every call (versions.go). Debian 12 for the GTK4 + WebKitGTK 6.0 path (the oldest distro shipping webkitgtk-6.0), Ubuntu 22.04 for the GTK3 legacy path. Confirmed by Lea, 2026-10-28.
